content.short: Mountain Protocol provides cutting-edge infrastructure for tokenized bonds rwas, empowering users with secure and transparent interactions.
content.description: Mountain Protocol is the issuer of USDM, a yield-bearing stablecoin backed by US Treasuries. Operating at the forefront of the Real World Asset Dapps sector, Mountain Protocol redefines how users interact with tokenized bonds rwas. The protocol leverages the advanced capabilities of Ethereum and Base and Arbitrum and Polygon to provide a seamless, non-custodial experience that guarantees user sovereignty. Its architecture is explicitly built for scale, accommodating high throughput and complex decentralized operations. With a strong commitment to open-source principles, Mountain Protocol stands out as a crucial utility in the modern Web3 tech stack.
